_comment: Advisory evals for generating-videos — deterministic keyword match, not merge-gating. One case per trigger surface (mode), cross-skill negatives (still-image requests route to generating-images; non-media asks don't trigger), and review-gate cases: a clip is not deliverable until frame_review.py + image_analysis have been run over its frames and the verdict quotes timestamps. The script itself is tested in tests/content_agent/test_frame_review.py.
trigger_keywords: turn this image into a video

cases.query: generate a video of waves crashing on a beach
create a video ad for our new sneaker launch
make a video of a city skyline timelapse at dusk
animate this product photo so it rotates slowly
turn this image into a video with gentle camera motion
make me some b-roll of coffee being poured
bring this photo to life with a slow push-in
make a talking clip that lip-syncs to this voiceover track
generate an image of a red bicycle in a city street
make a youtube thumbnail with the text BIG NEWS
what's the weather in Tokyo today
make a video of a woman walking in a garden, then review the frames before you send it
cases.mock_response: shot_1 (8 s, 16 frames @2fps): PASS — anatomy, garment consistency, physics, scene/camera, direction all clean; soft: t=6.0s slight background drift.

cases.query: this clip looks ai-generated, there are hallucinations in the video — check the frames and fix it
